segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常常用的句型。

segments.en: So you're saying specifically how much bigger or how much smaller the shoes are in the case with the ring or shoes or anything that has a size.
segments.zh: 所以你是在说，在戒指或鞋子或任何有尺寸的东西的情况下，鞋子有多大或多小。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: But the funny thing is you can also exaggerate.
segments.zh: 但有趣的是，你也可以夸大其词。

segments.en: You could say, oh, this sweater is so ugly.
segments.zh: 你可以说，哦，这件毛衣太丑了。

segments.en: It's 10 sizes too big for me.
segments.zh: 它对我来说太大了 10 个尺寸。

segments.en: It's not really 10 sizes.
segments.zh: 它不是真正的 10 种尺寸。

segments.en: It's not really 10 sizes.
segments.zh: 它不是真正的 10 种尺寸。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, but you can use this construction, right?
segments.zh: 所以，但是你可以使用这种结构，对吧？

segments.en: Using one size too big, etc.
segments.zh: 使用一种尺寸太大等。

segments.en: Even when you're buying something to the store, to the lady in the store, you can say, oh, I think the shoe is two sizes too big.
segments.zh: 就算在商店里买东西，对着店里的女士，你也可以说，哦，我觉得这只鞋大了两号。

segments.en: Can you give me a smaller pair?
segments.zh: 你能给我一双更小的吗？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And our third phrase for today, when the person said, yeah, you're right.
segments.zh: 而我们今天的第三个短语，当这个人说，是的，你是对的。

segments.en: When it comes down to it, I can be pretty tacky.
segments.zh: 说到底，我挑东西的品味还真有点俗。

segments.en: So we looked at tacky, but what does he mean when it comes down to it?
segments.zh: 我们讲过了 tacky，但他说 when it comes down to it 是什么意思呢？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, this it is very confusing sometimes when we talk about phrases in English, but when it comes down to it as a way to say in reality or actually, or the truth is yes.
segments.zh: 好吧，讲英语短语时，这个 it 有时确实很让人困惑，但 when it comes down to it 就是表示“实际上”“说到底”，或者说“事实确实如此”。

segments.en: So it's a way to say something is truthful.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种说某事是真实的方式。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So I can say when it comes down to it, Catherine is a good friend.
segments.zh: 所以我可以这样说：说到底，凯瑟琳是个好朋友。

segments.en: Oh, right.
segments.zh: 哦，对了。

segments.en: So when times are tough or in the end, or actually maybe you have your small faults, but you are a good friend.
segments.zh: 所以就是在日子难过的时候，或者说到最后，也许你有些小缺点，但你是个好朋友。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And when it comes down to it, Marco is a really hard worker.
segments.zh: 归根结底，Marco 是一个非常努力的人。

segments.en: So sometimes he likes to play video games, but when it's a really important, he will work really hard.
segments.zh: 所以有时他喜欢玩电子游戏，但当它非常重要时，他会非常努力地工作。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So very good uses of this phrase and you can use it in many different contexts.
segments.zh: 这个短语用得非常好，而且你可以在很多不同的语境里用它。

segments.en: And for our fourth phrase, when the person said, yeah, tell me about it.
segments.zh: 我们的第四个短语，是这个人说的一句话：是啊，tell me about it。

segments.en: What does it mean?
segments.zh: 这是什么意思？

segments.en: Tell me about it.
segments.zh: 可不是嘛。

segments.en: Tell me about what?
segments.zh: 告诉我什么？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, this is a really very popular phrase.
segments.zh: 嗯，这是一个非常流行的短语。

segments.en: You hear this all the time and it's, it's a way to say, yeah, I agree.
segments.zh: 你一直听到这个，这是一种说，是的，我同意的方式。

segments.en: I understand.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: I understand.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: So this is, this is a phrase that means agreement.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个表示赞同的短语。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So I can say, God, I really hate winter because when I leave work, it's always really dark.
segments.zh: 所以我可以说，上帝，我真的很讨厌冬天，因为当我下班时，天总是很黑。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Tell me about it.
segments.zh: 可不是嘛。

segments.en: It's always dark and it makes me feel lazy.
segments.zh: 它总是很黑，它让我感到懒惰。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And so Marco is agreeing.
segments.zh: 所以马可同意了。

segments.en: He says, I don't like it either.
segments.zh: 他说，我也不喜欢。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So this is a very, very spoken way, spoken language way of agreeing with someone.
segments.zh: 所以这是非常口语化的、表示赞同别人的说法。

segments.en: So you say, yeah, tell me about it.
segments.zh: 所以你说，是啊，tell me about it。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It's very natural.
segments.zh: 这是非常自然的。

segments.en: It's a very natural way of agreeing with someone.
segments.zh: 这是与某人达成一致的一种非常自然的方式。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So great phrases.
segments.zh: 这么棒的短语。

segments.en: Why don't we take a look at our dialogue for the last time and we'll be back to talk a little bit more.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不看看我们最后一次的对话，我们会回来多谈谈。

segments.en: Bill, Bill, you gotta help me.
segments.zh: 比尔，比尔，你得帮帮我。

segments.en: What's wrong?
segments.zh: 怎么了？

segments.en: Slow down or you're going to give yourself a heart attack.
segments.zh: 慢慢来，否则你会心脏病发作。

segments.en: Tomorrow's Christmas and I haven't bought my mom anything.
segments.zh: 明天就是圣诞节，我还没给妈妈买任何东西。

segments.en: I'm such a bad son.
segments.zh: 我真是个坏儿子。

segments.en: Take it easy.
segments.zh: 别着急。

segments.en: Let's go to the mall, window shop a little and see if there's anything she might like.
segments.zh: 咱们去商场逛逛，看看橱窗里有没有她可能喜欢的东西。

segments.en: That's just it.
segments.zh: 问题就在这里。

segments.en: I don't know what to get her.
segments.zh: 我不知道该给她什么。

segments.en: Last year I got her a ring that was two sizes too big and a pair of shoes five sizes too small.
segments.zh: 去年我给她买的戒指大了两号，鞋子却小了五码。

segments.en: I suck at getting presents for people.
segments.zh: 我特别不擅长给人挑礼物。

segments.en: That's where you're making a big mistake.
segments.zh: 这就是你犯了一个大错误的地方。

segments.en: You can't just guess people's likes or sizes, especially with clothes or jewelry.
segments.zh: 你不能只是猜测人们的喜好或大小，尤其是衣服或珠宝。

segments.en: On top of that, I think that you should get your mom something that shows how much you love her.
segments.zh: 最重要的是，我认为你应该给你妈妈一些东西，这表明你有多爱她。

segments.en: At the same time, you should show her that you took the time and effort to look for something that she would really like.
segments.zh: 同时，你应该向她表明你花时间和精力去寻找她真正想要的东西。

segments.en: Yeah, you're right.
segments.zh: 对，你说得对。

segments.en: When it comes down to it, I can be pretty tacky.
segments.zh: 说到底，我挑东西的品味还真有点俗。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Tell me about it.
segments.zh: 可不是嘛。

segments.en: I know.
segments.zh: 我知道。

segments.en: Your mom is trying to learn Spanish, right?
segments.zh: 你妈妈想学西班牙语，对吧？

segments.en: Why don't you get her a gift certificate for this great website I saw called SpanishPod?
segments.zh: 我见过一个很棒的网站叫 SpanishPod，你为什么不买张它的礼品卡送给她呢？

segments.en: Now that's a great idea.
segments.zh: 现在这是个好主意。

segments.en: All right, great.
segments.zh: 好，太好了。

segments.en: So now that the Christmas.
segments.zh: 所以现在圣诞节。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So as we said, gift certificates are a good idea, but what else do you like to give as Christmas presents?
segments.zh: 正如我们所说，礼券是一个好主意，但你还想送什么作为圣诞礼物？

segments.en: Personally, I like things that people really think about and spend their time doing or making.
segments.zh: 就个人而言，我喜欢人们真正思考和花时间做或做的事情。

segments.en: So I like, for example, my mom is a beautiful quilter.
segments.zh: 比如，我喜欢我妈妈做的东西，她是个做拼布被的高手。

segments.en: She makes these big blankets and quilts them.
segments.zh: 她做大毯子，还会绗缝。

segments.en: And sometimes she even quilts names of people and stuff.
segments.zh: 有时她甚至把人的名字之类的缝上去。

segments.en: And so those are really wonderful gifts because the person thinks about you and who you are and what you want.
segments.zh: 所以这些都是非常棒的礼物，因为这个人会想你、你是谁以及你想要什么。

segments.en: And so I like to be able to give gifts like that, but I'm not necessarily that creative.
segments.zh: 所以我喜欢能够送出这样的礼物，但我不一定有那么有创意。

segments.en: So I think it's nice to give gifts like tickets to a music show or things like that where you know the person will go and have a good time and enjoy themselves.
segments.zh: 所以我觉得送音乐演出的门票之类的礼物挺好，因为你知道对方会去玩得开心、享受其中。

segments.en: Yeah, I think that's really important because sometimes people just give gifts because you have to.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这真的很重要，因为有时人们只是送礼物，因为你必须这样做。

segments.en: Stuff.
segments.zh: 东西。

segments.en: Yeah, like stuff.
segments.zh: 是的，喜欢的东西。

segments.en: And you're like, oh, great.
segments.zh: 你就像，哦，太好了。

segments.en: A tie.
segments.zh: 领带。

segments.en: It's kind of impersonal.
segments.zh: 这有点没有人情味。

segments.en: At the same time, if your dad or your boyfriend or somebody loves ties and has 50 of them and you get them another one that's really interesting or unique, then great.
segments.zh: 同时，如果你的爸爸、男朋友或某个人喜欢领带，已经有 50 条了，而你又送他一条特别有趣或独特的，那也很好。

segments.en: But it is good to take the time to get somebody something they really like or they would really use or enjoy.
segments.zh: 但是花时间给某人他们真正喜欢的东西或者他们会真正使用或享受的东西是件好事。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So what kind of gifts do you plan to give this holiday season?
segments.zh: 那么这个假期你打算送什么样的礼物呢？

segments.en: Do you celebrate Christmas?
segments.zh: 你庆祝圣诞节吗？

segments.en: Let us know on our website EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 在我们的网站 englishpod.com 上让我们知道。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: And until next time.
segments.zh: 那么，下次见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
